sources.title: Burmese-GPT: An Open-Source Burmese Language Model - Freely Available ...
sources.snippet: Model Overview Burmese-GPT is a large-scale language model specifically designed for the Burmese language, fine-tuned/pre-trained based on the GPT-2 architecture (particularly the mGPT XL model). Primarily used for Burmese text completion tasks, it can serve as a foundational model for Burmese natural language processing tasks.
